text:
Maya: Heads up—sushi cart rolling up to the patio at 5:30! Also, we just crossed 1.2M ARR 🎉🥳
Sam: Wait WHAT, 1.2M?? Huge!!! :tada:
Kevin: omg congrats team!! sushi and champagne? :sake:
Alisha: I'll bring a tiny speaker for sunset playlist. Suggestions? chill lo-fi or guilty-pleasure pop?
Jin: Lo-fi for focus, but we deserve guilty pop. vote: :thumbsup: lo-fi, :heart: pop
Lina: Pop vote from me. Also need to save a veggie roll pls
OpsBot: Deploy-note: no infra changes planned during celebrations. Enjoy! :robot_face:
Sam: Can someone snag a table near the west railing? I have a tripod for the group photo.
Maya: I'll get the table. @Kevin can you bring the camera or your phone with portrait mode?
Kevin: Yup, portrait mode ready. Also can we do a 15s boomerang? :camera_flash:
Alisha: Playlist poll: "sunset vibes" or "kitchen karaoke"—react with :one: or :two:
Jin: Also shoutout to @Alex for the Dedicated contract push—makes this milestone tangible.
Sam: big kudos to Alex + infra team. we crushed the rollout.
Maya: tiny prize for best milestone toast — best improv toast wins a redwood mug :coffee:
Lina: I call dibs on writing a punny toast.
Kevin: If anyone wants a quiet corner, the back conference room has power outlets for laptops (not that anyone should be working).
Alisha: Can we get a tiny sign: "No standups here" 😂
Maya: ok last one — see you at 5:30, bring smiles and chopsticks. photos will go to #all-hands later :sparkles:
